definition: to set something in place ready for use
description: A lakeside campsite at dusk, with dark pine forest and blue mountains behind the still water. A young woman in a cream knitted jumper, olive trousers and a head torch crouches by a ring of stones and carefully lays thin sticks upright in a cone over birch bark to build a campfire. She then sits back, takes a match from between her lips and holds it up with a smile. A chopping block with an axe and a pile of split logs stand beside her, a kettle and a frying pan sit on the stones, and a lantern glows by a canvas tent.

to rest beside the frying pan
